improvements: After extinguishing a fire barrier, the bot keeps the required return trip active while freshly observed frost blocks the approach. It can briefly observe from safe ground instead of abandoning required loot or pursuing unrelated preparation.
incoming_learnings: Extinguishing a barrier is not the same as opening a currently safe route. Keep the required return transaction active while freshly observed frost blocks the approach, reobserve only from safe ground, and require actual hazard clearance and pickup evidence before crediting progress. Do not reinterpret stale cold as safe or abandon mandatory upgrade collection.

review.review: The run ended with a living hero at full health, not an observed death. The initiating blocker was the pool chest first observed at decision 1413 (log line 4122). The hero was already hungry, carried no food or known invisibility, and had no identify scroll, intuition stone or potion bandolier. Decision 1420 (line 4138) explicitly reports the unfinished pool reward, but preparation declines: tools/piranha_tactics.py delegates to tools/puzzle_supplies.py, whose hungry non-frost testing gate rejects the available unknown potions. Ordinary exploration continues without resolving that prerequisite. The first descent veto at decision 1495 leads to blink fallback, not collection. At decision 1537, the accepted waterskin drink restores one HP but supplies neither food nor invisibility. Decision 1538 (lines 4499–4500) exhausts the planner. Its recorded recovery rejection concerns escape or hunger admission, not demonstrated physical unreachability of the stairs; the hunger report has zero optional turns. All 4501 log records were examined. Independent first-sighting selector fixtures, not reconstructed original memory, found no admitted fresh test bank or dry-approach journey, even on an isolated hypothetical fed copy. Thus simply removing hunger would not establish safe preparation. Complete source browsing resolved the selecting-chain gap but did not establish an executable replacement. No patch or new regression is supplied because the observed resources do not fund hunger recovery or non-drinking identification, and no jointly safe testing, inventory-storage and return transaction was validated. The unchanged Python suite passed 2235 tests with four skips; no red/green repair claim is made. Mandatory progression pickups, hazard checks, genuine collection receipts and terminal planner exhaustion remain unchanged.
review.learnings: Recognizing a pool and reserving its floor potion does not establish executable preparation. Check hunger funding, fresh testing ground, inventory protection and the complete reward return together. A generated floor supply does not identify a carried color. Blink or healing fallback may advance the clock without resolving the initiating obligation.

recommendations.summary: Establish an executable, safely funded preparation transaction for an unfinished pool before descent becomes the only proposed progress.
evidence: Decision 1413, log line 4122: chest 1381 and three giant piranhas first appear; the hungry hero has no food or known invisibility.
Decision 1420, log line 4138: the pool reward is explicitly pending, but the supply controller declines and exploration proceeds.
Decision 1495, log lines 4357–4359: the pool descent veto leads to blink fallback, without collection credit.
Decision 1537, accepted log line 4498: waterskin restores one HP but does not resolve the missing preparation.
Decision 1538, log lines 4499–4500: planner exhaustion with full health; recovery rejects escape or hunger admission.
recommendations.reason: No safe focused patch is established. The initiating and terminal inventories lack food, identified invisibility and non-drinking identification supplies. An independent first-sighting fixture admits neither a fresh testing bank nor a dry-approach journey, even with hunger removed on an isolated copy. Lowering hunger or hazard checks would therefore not certify a replacement. Next derive paired first-sighting and surveyed-exterior fixtures, preflight a dry observation approach with fresh arrival, remote storage, protection-funded reward return and an actual hunger source, then add a new original-red/candidate-green regression for the executable handoff. If those resources cannot support preparation, separately certify dry-bank ranged pool clearance; the existing aquarium helper is not sufficient evidence. Preserve mandatory pickups and terminal exhaustion.
